summary: Frontend-only regression test of DynoPay perf batch (SWR dedupe + AbortController). Login->dashboard, /wallet page, Add Wallet modal, and company switcher inspected. Read-only, no mutations. Fee-free-status dedupe confirmed (1 call). Minor: reusable-wallets fires 2x on /wallet load.

integration_issues.issue: GET /api/wallet/reusable-wallets fires 2x on /wallet page load (spec: at most once). Possible SWR key collision or dual mount (WalletReuseSelector rendered outside modal, or StrictMode double-invoke). Not a functional break, but worth investigating in useReusableWallets to ensure the modal-only render path is truly gated.
